result.instructions: Tools for Galaxy Digital, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which volunteer needs are open right now, and how many volunteers does each still need?"; "Show the responses to our food bank shift and who signed up."; "How many volunteer hours were logged and approved this month?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Galaxy Digital data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run galaxydigital_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run galaxydigital_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run galaxydigital_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. galaxydigital_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.
